up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL3639086. Return the document identifier, compound ChEMBL ID, compound preferred name, and the canonical SMILES string. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT
  'CHEMBL3639086' AS document_identifier,
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_preferred_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM compound_records cr
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE cr.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639086')
